title: fix(runtime): AppPlugin registers the forward-converted copy of every collection
body:
Fixes #22994
Clause-②: no

Door 2 only, as triage graded it. Door 1 (the conversion window in `packages/metadata-core`) is #23001, untouched here.

## What changes

`AppPlugin.init()` handed the `manifest` service the RAW bundle. That service decomposes it into the ObjectQL registry over `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`. The registry is the code layer of the flattened list that `GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE` serves and that `getMetaItemsForExecution` hands to the email template loader. On the artifact boot, the door (`MetadataPlugin`) registered the forward-converted copy into the metadata service. So the item read served the converted copy while the list served the raw one.

Now the boot runs ONE ADR-0087 forward conversion (`forwardConverted`, memoized, `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`):

- It runs after the D1 handshake (`assertProtocolCompat` is unmoved and still first).
- Its input is `{ ...manifest, ...collections }`, the definition the security block has converted since the #12844 work. For a bundle without `packages[]`, that is byte for byte the payload `init()` always registered.
- Both registrars take its result: `manifest.register(...)` in `init()`, and the ADR-0057 security block in `start()`, which no longer converts on its own. No reader converts again: `readFlattenedMetaItems` and the email loader are untouched.

Why this input and not `this.bundle`:

- **Converting before the spread would turn the #18034 pin red.** The `manifest-permissions-string-list-removed` entry would strip `manifest.permissions` before the registrar sees it. The "2 of 2" warning would then describe a value that never arrived.
- **The #18034 source decision still reads the RAW inputs.** `fromManifest` reads `this.collections.manifest` and `this.collections[field]`, unchanged, because the conversion can rewrite a collection key (`roles` to `positions`).
- **The artifact-boot branch of the security block is unchanged.** Under `securityMetadataRegistrar: 'artifact-door'` it registers nothing and logs the same debug line.
- **A bundle with `packages[]` is handed over as authored, as before.** Resolving `packages[]` in `init()` is reserved to the `manifest` service by the posture the plugin-dev #15292 falsifier pins (4/4 green against the rebuilt `dist`). Also, no conversion reaches package bodies, at the artifact door either (measured, see Acceptance notes).

## Measured, before and after

The card's door: `os dev -a dist/objectstack.json --fresh` on an undeclared-engines artifact (`objectstack-ai/objectstack` at BASE `6a7eca6868`, then at this branch), read over HTTP.

**The second type is `dashboard`, converted by the major-18 retired entry `dashboard-refresh-interval-to-refresh-interval-seconds`** (retiredAfter 17.3.0).

| read | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard`, ops_board | `refreshInterval: 300`, `_diagnostics.valid: false` (the tombstone's rename prescription) | `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `valid: true` |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/ops_board` | `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `valid: true` | `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, `valid: true` (the same document as the list) |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template`, probe.welcome | carries `category` / `isSystem`, `valid: true` | unchanged |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/probe.welcome` | the door's parsed copy, `valid: true` | unchanged |

On this tree `category` / `isSystem` are live keys: their retirement is #22990, which is parked on this card. So the email half was measured on #22990's head `e4e96505e0` with and without this patch, in a scratch tree, through the real `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` over the booted kernel's protocol service:

- **Without the patch:**
  - the list carries `category: custom`, `isSystem: false` with `_diagnostics.valid: false`;
  - the item read is clean;
  - the loader refuses: "email template 'probe.welcome' (en-US) is not a valid email template, so it cannot be sent: `email_template.category` was removed…".
- **With the patch:**
  - the list is valid with both keys gone;
  - the loader sends `{ name: probe.welcome, locale: en-US, subject: Welcome, body_html, active: true }`.

The list and the item still differ on the PARSE axis: the door's copy carries the email schema's `variables: []` / `active: true` defaults. That is route ownership (#12892), not this conversion. The pins assert "every key the list serves equals the item's", never "one document", except for the dashboard, where the two really are one document.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin-converted-collections.test.ts`:

- **A real `createStandaloneStack` boot over the card's artifact.** Four checks:
  - the dashboard list equals the item read, `valid: true`;
  - the dashboard execution face equals the conversion's own output;
  - every key of the email list equals the item read's, `valid: true`;
  - the email execution face equals the conversion's output and passes the loader's own predicate, `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema.safeParse(stripReadDecorations(item))`.
- **A control boot of the same app in current spellings:** the registry holds the authored items plus stamps, nothing rewritten.
- **Three unit legs:**
  - one conversion: the security registrar registers the very object the manifest payload carries (identity, not equality);
  - a current bundle is handed over with its collection arrays by reference;
  - a `packages[]` bundle is handed over as authored.

The email legs are positive controls on this tree. **Measured on #22990's head:** this file is 8/8 green with the patch and 5 red without it, both email legs included. So they become live pins the day that retirement lands, with no edit.

Ablation of the one conversion line in `init()`, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:

- **Mutation landed:** anchor 1 to 0, blob `39d6bb3b6958` to `891daa76d2b3`.
- **The predicted three went red:**
  - the dashboard list pin ("expected undefined to be 300");
  - the dashboard execution-face pin;
  - the one-conversion unit leg.
- **The other 18 stayed green,** including every #14491 pin (the BASE behaviour), at `86d2782f09`, before the patch round rewrote five of those pins.
- **Restore proven:** blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **No rebuild was needed:** `app-plugin.ts` reaches the runtime suite by relative source import. The before and after probe differed without one.

All on `86d2782f09`:

- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`:** at `0f6556d1c5`, 357 of 357 files and 5141 tests pass, 19 skipped.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`:** exit 0; the test layer held its debt ledger. `tsc --listFiles` compiles the new file with 0 errors in it.
- **Untouched pins, green:**
  - #12844 / #12892: `app-plugin-artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts`, `standalone-stack-security-registrar.test.ts`;
  - #18034: `app-plugin.manifest-security-collision.test.ts`.
- **Gates:** all 63 derived by `dispatch-gates.mjs` exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) and was measured green after building the 10 missing `dist`s. `--ran` reconciliation: "63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".
- **Lint:** narrowed to the two touched sources, with the three proofs:
  - `--print-config` puts both in eslint's population;
  - `--format json` reports 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings;
  - no config object enables type-aware linting (every `parserOptions` is `{ ecmaVersion, sourceType }`), and the four custom rules are AST-local, so no untouched file's verdict can move.

## #14491's measurement: five conversion-axis pins rewritten (seat ruling A, `6122651929` → claim `6121395708` widened)

`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts` now pins the converged conversion axis. None of the five pins is skipped, relaxed or deleted; each keeps its subject and asserts the measured converged values (commit `0f6556d1c5`):

1. permission `probe_agent`: the registry grant map and RLS entry carry no `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` / `priority`. The three door defaults are still absent (the parse axis).
2. The stored `sys_permission_set` RLS equals the door's.
3. `share_legacy_deals` carries `sharedWith.type: position` and `accessLevel: edit` in the registry, equal to the door's.
4. `share_legacy_level` carries `accessLevel: edit` in the registry.
5. **An authorization outcome.** `share_legacy_deals` is now SEEDED, exactly once, as a position share: `recipient_type: position`, `recipient_id: sales_mgr`, `access_level: edit`. That gives three rows where there were two. Before this PR it was dropped at seeding (`role` is refused by `mapRecipientType`). The changeset says so.

The file's header now records that #22994 closed the conversion axis, while the parse axis (string `condition`, and the missing `scope` / `isDefault` / `active` defaults) stays #14491's. Those pins are unchanged.

Ablating the `init()` conversion line turns exactly the five rewritten pins red against the raw registry copy (`5 failed | 8 passed`). The restore is proven against HEAD.

Open PR #22962 (#15204 stage 8) edits the same file and deletes pin 2; whichever lands second merges `main`. The seat declared this on #15204.

## Acceptance notes (not this PR)

- **The conversion layer does not reach option-B package bodies.** Measured: the artifact door (`_parseAndRegisterArtifact`) refuses an artifact whose only dashboard sits in `packages[0].manifest.dashboards` with `refreshInterval`, with "invalid_type at packages.0.manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval". The conversion walks a definition's own collections. Same family as #23001, for the seat to route.
- **Readers of the raw `this.bundle` / `this.collections` after the seam, answered for assumption 5.** Each reader takes one of three answers: it needs the converted copy, it keeps the raw one, or it does not care.
  - **Datasources** (`codeDefinedDatasourceOwners`, the in-memory `datasource` registration, `connectDeclared`): raw. The drivers read `config.timeoutMs` / `persistence.autoSaveIntervalMs`, so a datasource still carrying the retired `config.timeout` (turso) or `autoSaveInterval` (memory) loses the value at connect.
  - **Jobs** (`scheduleAppArtifactJobs(ctx, this.bundle)`): raw. The binder reads `job.timeoutMs`, so a retired `jobs[].timeout` schedules with no timeout.
  - These two are retired keys a consumer reads. Reported, not converted here, as the dispatch ruled.
  - **Does not care:**
    - `datasourceMapping`, objects passed to `connectDeclared` (read for `name` / `datasource` only), seed `data`: no conversion targets what they read;
    - hooks: the binder reads no `timeout` / `timeoutMs`;
    - `emitCatalogEvent`, `grantedPermissions`: no conversion touches them.
  - **Translations** (`loadTranslations`): NOT MEASURED.
  - **Residual of a multi-package config stack** (`registerUnclaimedTopLevel`): raw, same class.
